title: MAVRICS: A Robust and Safe Magnetic Nanoparticle RNA Extraction Method
author: Mo Li
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.b2p8qdrw
materials: Magnetic-nanoparticle-Aided Viral RNA Isolation of Contagious Samples .

steps.title: Synthesize Silica Magnetic Nanoparticles (SiMNP)
steps.instruction: Synthesize SiMNP following the BOMB.bio protocols for magnetic core nanoparticles synthesis and coating ferrite MNPs with silica oxide.

steps.title: Prepare Bis-Tris Buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare the Bis-Tris buffer by dissolving reagents in ethanol and adjusting pH.

substeps.instruction: Dissolve 14.33 g guanidinium hydrochloride and 104.6 mg Bis-Tris (or 10 mM Tris Base as a substitute) in 50 mL of 90% ethanol.
Add 90% ethanol to reach a final volume of 45-48 mL and mix until guanidinium hydrochloride is completely dissolved.
Adjust pH to <6.5 using HCl.
Adjust the final volume to 50 mL using 90% ethanol.

steps.title: Prepare Patient Samples
steps.instruction: Steep oropharyngeal or nasopharyngeal swabs in 1 mL acid guanidinium thiocyanate-phenol-chloroform (AGPC, e.g., TRIzol Reagent or TRI reagent).

steps.title: Bind RNA to SiMNPs
steps.instruction: Combine the clinical sample with buffer and SiMNPs to bind RNA.

substeps.instruction: In a Lo-Bind Eppendorf tube, add 200 µL clinical sample and 200 µL Bis-Tris buffer; mix well by vortexing.
Prepare SiMNP stock by diluting with RNase-free water (recommended 1 volume SiMNP stock to 4 volumes RNase-free water for swab samples mixed with TRIzol; typical range 1:4 to 1:10).
Add 40 µL of the diluted SiMNP to the tube and mix at 1300 rpm for 5 minutes.
Spin the tube for 2-3 seconds, settle the SiMNPs on a magnetic stand, and remove the supernatant.

steps.title: Wash SiMNPs
steps.instruction: Perform a series of washes to remove contaminants.

substeps.instruction: Mix 200 µL of AGPC (TRIzol or TRI reagent) and 200 µL Bis-Tris buffer, add to the SiMNPs, and mix well by vortexing.
Settle the SiMNPs on a magnetic stand and remove the supernatant.
Add 400 µL of fresh 90% ethanol, mix well, spin for 2-3 seconds, settle on a magnetic stand, and remove the supernatant.
Repeat the 90% ethanol wash three more times for a total of 4 ethanol washes.

steps.title: Dry and Elute RNA
steps.instruction: Dry the nanoparticles and recover the RNA.

substeps.instruction: Dry the SiMNPs on a heat block at 50°C with the lid open and no shaking until they appear rusty brownish in color (approx. 20 min).
Add 40 µL nuclease-free water to elute RNA and mix at 1300 rpm for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Settle the SiMNPs on a magnetic stand and slowly transfer the eluted RNA to a new RNase-free tube, avoiding the nanoparticles.

steps.title: Analyze and Store RNA
steps.instruction: Quantify the RNA and store it appropriately.

substeps.instruction: Analyze RNA concentration and purity using a Qubit fluorometer or Nanodrop.
Store RNA at -80°C or use immediately.

steps.title: Perform Reverse Transcription (RT)
steps.instruction: Convert eluted RNA to cDNA using SuperScript™ IV Reverse Transcriptase.

substeps.instruction: Use 4 µL of eluted RNA (optimize input amount as needed).
Follow SuperScript™ IV instructions, ensuring the RNase H incubation step is included.
Prepare a 10 µL reaction mix containing: 1.5 µL cDNA, 0.5 µL SARS-CoV-2 (2019-nCoV) CDC qPCR Probe Assay, 5 µL TaqMan Fast Advanced Master Mix, and 1.5 µL nuclease-free water.
Run the reaction on a Biorad CFX384 Touch (or similar) using the following program: 50°C for 2 min, 95°C for 2 min, followed by 45 cycles of (95°C for 5 sec and 59°C for 30 sec).
